rows.speaker: Yassaba
rows.en: For President Kizz to throw in this much firepower, he must be seriously furious.
rows.display_text:
「For President Kizz to throw in this
much firepower, he must be seriously
furious.」

rows.speaker: Kashmir
rows.en: Which is exactly why we absolutely cannot afford to fail... You understand that, don't you!
rows.display_text:
「Which is exactly why we absolutely
cannot afford to fail... You understand
that, don't you!」

rows.speaker: Enge
rows.en: Of course. None of us want to lose our jobs, after all.
rows.display_text:
「Of course. None of us want to lose our
jobs, after all.」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: Well... with a lineup like this, there's no way we'd lose, not even one time in ten thousand.
rows.display_text:
「Well... with a lineup like this, there's
no way we'd lose, not even one time in
ten thousand.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Come on, then, Gain Bijou. Today I'll settle this once and for all...!
rows.display_text:
「Come on, then, Gain Bijou. Today I'll
settle this once and for all...!」

rows.speaker: Jaboli
rows.en: They're here! It's Yapan!!
rows.display_text: 「They're here! It's Yapan!!」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: Ha ha! Yapan's flying straight into the fire!
rows.display_text:
「Ha ha! Yapan's flying straight into the
fire!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Shut it, Kejinan! You're not even worth my attention!
rows.display_text:
「Shut it, Kejinan! You're not even worth
my attention!」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Target the commander units! Rushrod, Planeta, and Golem!
rows.display_text:
「Target the commander units! Rushrod,
Planeta, and Golem!」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: Don't bother with the small fry! Concentrate our attacks!
rows.display_text:
「Don't bother with the small fry!
Concentrate our attacks!」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Let's go, Gainer!
rows.display_text: 「Let's go, Gainer!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: I'll show you! The target's the boss character!!
rows.display_text:
「I'll show you! The target's the boss
character!!」

rows.speaker: Bello
rows.en: We did it! It's our win!
rows.display_text: 「We did it! It's our win!」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Phew... I suppose we managed to pull through today.
rows.display_text:
「Phew... I suppose we managed to pull
through today.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: All right, to celebrate our victory...
rows.display_text: 「All right, to celebrate our victory...」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Gauli Squad -- hip, hip, hooray!
rows.display_text: 「Gauli Squad -- hip, hip, hooray!」

rows.speaker: Bello
rows.en: Hooray!!
rows.display_text: 「Hooray!!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: No good... I just can't get used to this thing Sara does, no matter what...
rows.display_text:
（No good... I just can't get used to this
thing Sara does, no matter what...）

rows.speaker: Yassaba
rows.en: D-damn it all!! Adette! Get back here!!
rows.display_text: 「D-damn it all!! Adette! Get back here!!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Sorry, Boss. I've gone and found myself a better man than you over here.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry, Boss. I've gone and found myself
a better man than you over here.」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: Adette...
rows.display_text: 「Adette...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: This Exodus is what the man I fell for is staking his life on. I'll make sure it succeeds, no matter what!
rows.display_text:
「This Exodus is what the man I fell for
is staking his life on. I'll make sure it
succeeds, no matter what!」

rows.speaker: Kashmir
rows.en: H-how absurd!! My diamonds are getting scattered everywhere!!
rows.display_text:
「H-how absurd!! My diamonds are getting
scattered everywhere!!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Somehow, we won...
rows.display_text: 「Somehow, we won...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Too bad, Gainer. Looks like you didn't get your big chance to confess this time.
rows.display_text:
「Too bad, Gainer. Looks like you didn't
get your big chance to confess this time.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: T-that's...!
rows.display_text: 「T-that's...!」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Don't go thinking about unnecessary things in the middle of a battle!!
rows.display_text:
「Don't go thinking about unnecessary
things in the middle of a battle!!」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Ngh! Remember this, Gain! Next time, I will definitely take you down!!
rows.display_text:
「Ngh! Remember this, Gain! Next time, I
will definitely take you down!!」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Come at me anytime, Asuham. I'm just a contractor fulfilling my job.
rows.display_text:
「Come at me anytime, Asuham. I'm just a
contractor fulfilling my job.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: If you're going to keep getting in the way of the Exodus, I'll take you on as many times as it takes.
rows.display_text:
「If you're going to keep getting in the
way of the Exodus, I'll take you on as
many times as it takes.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: No good...! Keep this up and all we'll get is needless losses!
rows.display_text:
「No good...! Keep this up and all we'll
get is needless losses!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Is retreating our only choice...!
rows.display_text: 「Is retreating our only choice...!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: The Sibe Rail and Saint Regan joined forces just to crush us!?
rows.display_text:
「The Sibe Rail and Saint Regan joined
forces just to crush us!?」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: To them, Yapan's Ceiling is something they have to crush, even if it takes going that far.
rows.display_text:
「To them, Yapan's Ceiling is something
they have to crush, even if it takes
going that far.」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: According to the recon unit's report, it seems a considerable number of Overmen have been deployed.
rows.display_text:
「According to the recon unit's report, it
seems a considerable number of Overmen
have been deployed.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Yassaba Jin's Rushrod, Asuham Boone's Golem, Kashmir Valle's Planeta...
rows.display_text:
「Yassaba Jin's Rushrod, Asuham Boone's
Golem, Kashmir Valle's Planeta...」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Even Under Golems and Mexbrutes are out there.
rows.display_text:
「Even Under Golems and Mexbrutes are
out there.」

rows.speaker: Bello
rows.en: You're kidding me! How are we supposed to fight that!?
rows.display_text:
「You're kidding me! How are we supposed
to fight that!?」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: At times like this, you crush the head. Our target's the enemy's commander units.
rows.display_text:
「At times like this, you crush the head.
Our target's the enemy's commander units.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: In short, if we take down the Rushrod, Golem, and Planeta, this is settled.
rows.display_text:
「In short, if we take down the Rushrod,
Golem, and Planeta, this is settled.」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: Easier said than done, though.
rows.display_text: 「Easier said than done, though.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: But if we want the Exodus to succeed, we have no choice but to do it!
rows.display_text:
「But if we want the Exodus to succeed,
we have no choice but to do it!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Sara...
rows.display_text: 「Sara...」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: ...Can I count on you, Gainer?
rows.display_text: 「...Can I count on you, Gainer?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Good luck out there, Gainer -- you too.
rows.display_text:
「Good luck out there, Gainer -- you
too.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Y-yes, ma'am!
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes, ma'am!」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Now that that's settled, let's get ready. Operation time is seven minutes... the absolute limit we can hold the line.
rows.display_text:
「Now that that's settled, let's get
ready. Operation time is seven minutes...
the absolute limit we can hold the line.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Don't forget to set up according to each of your roles.
rows.display_text:
「Don't forget to set up according to
each of your roles.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Counting on you, Gainer. You and Gain are the attackers.
rows.display_text:
「Counting on you, Gainer. You and Gain
are the attackers.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Yes!
rows.display_text: 「Yes!」
